name: Commodity Money Conventions
mechanism: Recognize a transferable commodity as a generally accepted intermediate means of exchange
operating_requirement: Actual accepted goods, divisible quantities and willing trading partners
consequence: Reduce double-coincidence constraints while retaining storage loss and refusal risk

name: Unit of Account Conventions
mechanism: Express unlike obligations in one agreed valuation unit without requiring payment in that material
operating_requirement: Shared valuation convention and interpretable obligation records
consequence: Compare debts while keeping account units distinct from deliverable payment

name: Monetary Piece Stamping
mechanism: Mark standardized metal pieces with an issuer claim of denomination and quality
operating_requirement: Metal stock, blanks, dies, striking labor and trusted issuer
consequence: Reduce repeated weighing for accepted pieces; stamping cannot guarantee purity or acceptance

name: Redeemable Payment Notes
mechanism: Issue transferable payment promises with stated redemption obligations
operating_requirement: Identifiable issuer, authentic notes, actual redemption assets and enforceable terms
consequence: Transfer issuer credit while exposing holders to redemption delays and default

name: Payment Token Authentication
mechanism: Use repeatable identifying features and comparison checks to distinguish authorized tokens
operating_requirement: Controlled issuance tools, reference pieces and trained inspection
consequence: Reduce undetected imitation at a continuing inspection cost

name: Price Observation Registers
mechanism: Record comparable transactions with quantities, quality, place and observation time
operating_requirement: Observed trades, record keepers and shared quantity definitions
consequence: Reveal local price variation without granting unseen market information

name: Commodity Price Indices
mechanism: Combine comparable price observations using a stated basket and weights
operating_requirement: Repeated observations, basket definitions and revision records
consequence: Track basket price changes while exposing substitution and coverage limits

name: Currency Conversion Quotations
mechanism: State exchange ratios between accepted payment units with explicit fees and validity
operating_requirement: Willing counterparties, actual balances and current observed quotations
consequence: Support conversion without assuming infinite liquidity or fixed rates

name: Purchasing Power Comparison
mechanism: Compare the cost of matched baskets across monetary areas
operating_requirement: Comparable goods, local prices and quality adjustments
consequence: Separate nominal conversion from differences in attainable goods

name: Ascending Bid Auctions
mechanism: Allocate a specified lot through successively higher public bids under a stopping rule
operating_requirement: Real lot, eligible bidders, credible bids and settlement procedure
consequence: Discover a transaction price with delay and collusion risks

name: Sealed Bid Auctions
mechanism: Collect confidential offers before a fixed close and apply a declared ranking and payment rule
operating_requirement: Secure offer custody, comparable lot terms and qualified bidders
consequence: Trade public price discovery for a bounded submission period

name: Reverse Procurement Auctions
mechanism: Compare competing supplier offers against one specified deliverable and acceptance rule
operating_requirement: Qualified suppliers, genuine demand and deliverable quality tests
consequence: Reduce purchasing cost only when actual capable suppliers compete

name: Double Auction Matching
mechanism: Match buyer bids and seller offers under declared priority rules
operating_requirement: Actual orders, available goods or balances and settlement capacity
consequence: Coordinate repeated trades while retaining unmatched orders and market-power effects

name: Package Bid Allocation
mechanism: Select mutually compatible package offers when complementary lots cannot be valued independently
operating_requirement: Explicit bundle bids, capacity limits and auditable allocation computation
consequence: Reduce exposure from winning an unusable subset without promising truthful bidding

name: Commodity Forward Delivery
mechanism: Agree quantity, grade, delivery location, date and price before physical delivery
operating_requirement: Credible counterparties and actual future production or sourcing capacity
consequence: Share price uncertainty while retaining harvest, transport and default risk

name: Exchange Contract Standardization
mechanism: Standardize contract sizes, grades, delivery windows and transferable positions
operating_requirement: Accepted specifications, position records and delivery governance
consequence: Make comparable forward positions transferable without manufacturing the underlying goods

name: Variation Margin Settlement
mechanism: Transfer collateral as marked contract exposure changes
operating_requirement: Observed settlement prices, real collateral and enforceable position limits
consequence: Limit accumulating unsecured exposure while creating liquidity calls

name: Option Exercise Contracts
mechanism: Trade a bounded right to transact under specified conditions without the holder's exercise obligation
operating_requirement: Premium payment, defined exercise terms and a capable obligated counterparty
consequence: Separate optional access from mandatory delivery with finite counterparty exposure

name: Market Liquidity Measurement
mechanism: Measure spread, available depth and execution slippage across observed order sizes
operating_requirement: Time-stamped orders and actual completed or attempted trades
consequence: Distinguish a quoted price from the cost of executing a large order

name: Loan and Deposit Creation Accounts
mechanism: Record a bank loan asset and corresponding deposit liability at origination and track repayment
operating_requirement: Authorized lending institution, credit assessment, capital and settlement liquidity
consequence: Model credit-created deposits as liabilities rather than newly created physical wealth

name: Credit Underwriting
mechanism: Assess promised repayment against observed income, obligations and downside cases
operating_requirement: Accessible borrower evidence, review labor and explicit uncertainty
consequence: Price or refuse credit without treating collateral or reputation as certain repayment

name: Amortization Schedules
mechanism: Separate each scheduled payment into accrued interest and principal reduction
operating_requirement: Agreed rate and timing conventions, records and actual payments
consequence: Expose remaining debt and payment timing instead of counting every payment as principal

name: Receivables Factoring
mechanism: Transfer verified receivable claims for discounted immediate payment with stated recourse
operating_requirement: Authentic invoices, buyer funds and debtor collection access
consequence: Release working cash while preserving fraud, nonpayment and fee exposure

name: Asset Leasing Accounts
mechanism: Separate paid temporary use of an asset from ownership and specify maintenance and return duties
operating_requirement: Actual serviceable asset, lessor capacity and enforceable use terms
consequence: Access equipment without outright purchase while retaining rent and repossession dependence

name: Insolvency Claim Resolution
mechanism: Rank and reconcile competing claims against insufficient assets through a disclosed process
operating_requirement: Verified claims, actual realizable assets and recognized adjudication
consequence: Distribute losses rather than erase liabilities or replenish missing resources

name: Insurance Risk Pooling
mechanism: Collect contributions against specified shared losses and pay from a finite pool
operating_requirement: Defined covered events, pooled reserves and trustworthy claims handling
consequence: Share individual shocks while exposing correlated losses and reserve exhaustion

name: Insurance Claim Adjustment
mechanism: Compare reported loss with coverage, evidence and recoverable value
operating_requirement: Accessible loss evidence, adjusters and actual available reserves
consequence: Pay qualified claims while preserving investigation cost and disagreement

name: Pension Contribution Accounts
mechanism: Track contributions and promised later benefits separately from the pool's actual assets
operating_requirement: Participant records, funding rules and finite invested or current contribution resources
consequence: Expose retirement obligations and funding gaps without guaranteed future purchasing power

name: Correlated Loss Stress Models
mechanism: Evaluate reserve sufficiency when multiple losses share common causes
operating_requirement: Joint exposure data, stated scenarios and model review
consequence: Reveal concentration missed by independent-loss assumptions without predicting every crisis

name: Wage and Time Accounts
mechanism: Link agreed compensation to recorded time and approved work periods
operating_requirement: Actual workers, supervisors, payment stock and interpretable time records
consequence: Make earned compensation auditable without creating labor or forcing employment

name: Piecework Compensation
mechanism: Pay for accepted output units with stated rejection and rework rules
operating_requirement: Measurable output, quality inspection, willing workers and payment resources
consequence: Change work incentives while exposing quality shortcuts and uneven earnings

name: Collective Bargaining Procedures
mechanism: Authorize representatives to negotiate shared working terms and ratify agreements
operating_requirement: Represented workers, counterparties and a recognized negotiation process
consequence: Support joint bargaining without automatic agreement or a universal productivity bonus

name: Employment Dispute Mediation
mechanism: Reconcile conflicting work and pay claims using evidence and mutually accepted mediation
operating_requirement: Accessible records, participants and mediator time
consequence: Offer a settlement route while allowing unresolved disputes and work interruption

name: Worker-Owned Enterprise Accounts
mechanism: Record worker membership claims, voting stakes and distribution of residual earnings
operating_requirement: Actual contributed assets, membership rules and operating records
consequence: Support worker ownership without assuming superior output or compulsory adoption

name: Consumer Cooperative Rebates
mechanism: Return eligible trading surplus according to recorded member purchases
operating_requirement: Real surplus after obligations, purchase records and agreed allocation rules
consequence: Separate patronage returns from capital dividends without inventing distributable funds

name: Household Budget Accounts
mechanism: Compare household receipts, essential outlays and remaining commitments over time
operating_requirement: Actual household resources and recorded obligations
consequence: Expose shortages and tradeoffs without reallocating households outside existing civic authority

name: Unpaid Work Time Surveys
mechanism: Sample time spent on care and other unpaid activities separately from paid employment
operating_requirement: Consenting representative respondents, time diaries and survey staff
consequence: Make otherwise unpriced labor visible without converting all activity into market output

name: Input-Output Production Accounts
mechanism: Record how outputs of one production activity become intermediate inputs of another
operating_requirement: Comparable sector boundaries, actual flow records and valuation conventions
consequence: Trace production dependence while avoiding double-counted intermediate output

name: National Income Reconciliation
mechanism: Reconcile production, expenditure and income views of a defined economy
operating_requirement: Survey coverage, institutional accounts and explicit boundary conventions
consequence: Detect accounting discrepancies without equating measured output with wellbeing

name: Research Patronage Agreements
mechanism: Support a scholar's bounded inquiry through negotiated subsistence, access and reporting duties
operating_requirement: A willing competent scholar, actual board or trade goods and local learning time
consequence: Sustain uncertain inquiry before formal research markets without purchasing guaranteed discoveries

name: Commissioned Research Scoping
mechanism: Define a purchased question, usable evidence, deliverables and acceptance limits before commissioning
operating_requirement: Known capable provider, payment resources and a locally interpretable question
consequence: Avoid paying for an irrelevant report while retaining uncertainty of a useful result

name: Research Milestone Payments
mechanism: Release agreed payment tranches against verified intermediate deliverables
operating_requirement: Escrowed or affordable funds, review capacity and honest evidence of milestones
consequence: Limit exposure to unfinished work without making failed hypotheses fraudulent by definition

name: Research Cost-Sharing Accounts
mechanism: Attribute contributed staff, equipment time, specimens and funds to a joint inquiry
operating_requirement: Actual partner contributions, accessible accounts and agreed valuation
consequence: Distribute research cost while exposing uneven participation and coordination overhead

name: Background Knowledge Access Terms
mechanism: Separate pre-existing partner knowledge from new jointly produced results and define access
operating_requirement: Identified knowledge holders, interpretable scope and accepted obligations
consequence: Prevent participation from automatically conveying every partner discovery

name: Technology Use Licenses
mechanism: Specify a bounded permission to use a controlled method with fees, scope and duration
operating_requirement: Willing holder, enforceable agreed terms and a recipient capable of the permitted use
consequence: Permit dependent use while leaving know-how transfer, equipment and independent mastery separate

name: Know-How Transfer Packages
mechanism: Combine demonstrations, process records and tacit-practice instruction for a defined method
operating_requirement: Competent instructors, transferable records, local equipment and repeated practice
consequence: Reduce reconstruction effort while leaving local qualification and missing tacit knowledge costs

name: Research Result Reproduction Acceptance
mechanism: Test whether delivered findings can be reproduced under the contracted conditions before final acceptance
operating_requirement: Comparable samples, local method capacity and finite independent evaluation
consequence: Distinguish purchased evidence from a locally demonstrated capability

name: Pooled Technology Access
mechanism: Aggregate complementary permissions under common access and allocation terms
operating_requirement: Actual participating rights holders, compatible terms and fee allocation records
consequence: Reduce repeated negotiations while retaining missing-rights and market-exclusion risks

name: Innovation Prize Commitments
mechanism: Commit a funded reward to a demonstrated outcome judged by predeclared criteria
operating_requirement: Credible reserved reward, feasible evaluation and voluntary capable entrants
consequence: Encourage competing approaches without ensuring a solution or covering every entrant's cost

name: Contingent Claim Exposure Nets
mechanism: Trace linked obligations across institutions and identify cascading settlement shortfalls
operating_requirement: Disclosed positions, counterparties and scenario computations
consequence: Expose systemic dependencies without assuming every bilateral cancellation is legally available

name: Autonomous Procurement Budget Limits
mechanism: Constrain a purchasing agent by authorized spend, counterparties, quantities and revocation rules
operating_requirement: Authenticated authority, real budget and auditable order execution
consequence: Delegate bounded procurement while retaining mistaken orders and human accountability

name: Long-Delay Delivery Acceptance
mechanism: Separate dispatch evidence, arrival evidence and final acceptance across long communication delays
operating_requirement: Actual cargo tracking, authenticated records and funded contingent obligations
consequence: Support distant trade without treating a departure message as completed delivery

name: Habitat Life-Support Cost Accounts
mechanism: Allocate finite maintenance, replenishment and reserve costs to life-support services
operating_requirement: Measured material and energy flows, occupied capacity and local operating staff
consequence: Expose the real cost of inhabited capacity without pricing permission to exist as an automatic policy

name: Recovery Material Value Models
mechanism: Value recovered material by usable grade, separation cost and actual reachable demand
operating_requirement: Assayed recoverable stocks, process costs and observed buyers
consequence: Distinguish gross scrap mass from economically usable recovery without overriding material conservation

name: Intergenerational Fund Draw Rules
mechanism: Set revisable withdrawals against future obligations, uncertain returns and replenishment needs
operating_requirement: Actual fund assets, disclosed beneficiaries and authorized oversight
consequence: Limit depletion while retaining loss, changing needs and contested allocation

name: Scarcity Allocation Mechanism Trials
mechanism: Compare declared allocation rules against measured access and strategic response under finite supply
operating_requirement: Representative trials, agreed evaluation criteria and real capacity constraints
consequence: Inform choices among queues, lotteries, bids and needs rules without imposing one system
